name: Real Story
promise: A real story shown through real records, with one question answered by the end.
rules: Only facts with status verified go into the narration; 'likely' facts must be hedged on screen and in words.
Quotes only from a transcript, with time and source.
Every real record on screen carries a source line; every illustration is labelled as such.
Secondary retellings help to find facts; only primary material goes on screen. No other creators' videos.
Synthetic voice, music and generated images are disclosed in the description and in the upload flag.
Thumbnail: clickbait but honest; everything promised is in the video.

fonts.display: Archivo (variable wdth 62-125, wght 100-900), titles at wdth 62 / 860

type_rules: no plates, boxes or borders behind text: legibility from size, a scrim of the episode ground and a soft shadow
signal red only for the stop block / redaction bar and thumbnail key words
episode accent for one word per kinetic line, routes and diagram strokes
style.image_style_prompt: Editorial documentary illustration in the palette of this episode: ground {ground}, light accents {accent}, soft film grain, cinematic side light, simple bold shapes, archival photo texture, no text, no logos, no watermarks.

voice.base_direction: Calm, even documentary narrator reading from the archive: plain American English, steady pace, matter-of-fact. No suspense voice, no whispering, no dramatic pauses, no acted emotion. The facts carry the tension, not the voice.
voice.emotion_range: narrow: emotion tags only nudge the tone (a little warmer, a little lower); never whisper, never urgent
